items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier Interview
items.q: The Young Tuxedo Band, Bush Hall. Oh, Bush Hall was the leader? ... Yeah. Bush Hall was the leader. ... I was financial secretary of the local. And then we kept that organization until Bush died.

ctx.x: You see the one that's still living?
Yes, the one's still living. And a fellow by the name of Bush Hall and Raymond Brown on trombone.
Well, I remember Lawrence used to talk about Bush Hall.
